title: Unique Research · May 2024 AI Product Traffic Rankings
summary: Unique Research ranks AI products by monthly website visits, combining our independent industry tracking of nearly 10,000 global AI products (and nearly 1,000 China-market products) with Similarweb third-party data.
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Rankings · June 11, 2024

Unique Research ranks AI products by monthly website visits, combining our independent industry tracking of nearly 10,000 global AI products (and nearly 1,000 China-market products) with Similarweb third-party data.

Boards in this release

  • Global AI Products TOP 100 — worldwide, ranked by monthly visits.
  • China AI Products TOP 100 — includes China-founded products for the domestic market and China/Chinese-diaspora founders’ products aimed overseas, ranked by visits.

Note: Source HTML for this slug carries 0 embedded board images (inventory imageCount=0). On ingest, attach or redraw boards from the live QQ/ffcap archive if recovered; methodology below still stands.

Data notes

  • Traffic from Similarweb, labeled/classified by Unique Research; errors/omissions possible; reference only — not investment advice.
  • Covers PC/mobile browser visits to product sites only — not browser extensions, standalone apps, Discord/third-party apps, mini-programs, or local open-source runs.
  • Overseas = foreign founders for overseas markets; Domestic = Chinese founders for China; Go-global / outbound = Chinese or Chinese-diaspora founders for overseas markets.

Metric — Visits

Total visits (sessions). A visit counts when a user views one or more pages; further pageviews stay in the same visit until 30 minutes of inactivity (then a new visit). Crossing midnight starts a new session.

About Unique Research

Unique Research is Unique Capital’s center for new-business innovation — marketing, retail, experience, and digitization across consumer, local services, healthcare, and more, with analyst backgrounds in research, PE, and tech media.
